## Recovered observations

192 points (from FA-18) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b2`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Caption says RSM; specification is soil 5 RSM-a. Inset D50 2.4 mm (2.3-2.4); D10 1.5 mm (1.4-1.6); Cu 1.6; D95 2.7 mm (2.7-2.8); agrees with Table 2-3. F2-14 RSM-a and PS labels may be swapped (see b68-gs-fa-6).
- Codex: Three samples; caption says RSM; specification identifies RSM-a. Individual sample identities missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-18, printed A-38, PDF 39
